summary: Completed testing of Skills & Categories Matching feature. All 16 backend API tests pass (100%). Fixed a bug where /api/auth/login and /api/auth/me endpoints were not returning the user's skills field. Frontend Techniciens page shows skills column with colored badges and skills management dialog. Tech PWA profile menu now correctly displays technician's skills.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Skills filtering logic in /api/interventions/available, /api/interventions/today, and /api/interventions?include_available=true correctly filters by technician skills
server.py: PUT /api/users/{id}/skills validates category IDs exist before updating
server.py: Polyvalent techs (empty skills array) can see ALL available interventions - correct behavior
push_service.py: notify_new_intervention_available_to_techs correctly sends notifications only to qualified techs
Techniciens.jsx: SkillsManager component with multi-select checkboxes and colored category badges
TechnicianApp.jsx: ProfileMenu displays user skills with colored badges from categories
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed /api/auth/login and /api/auth/me to include skills field in UserResponse
/app/backend/tests/test_skills_matching.py - Created comprehensive test suite for skills matching feature
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing technicians: Jean Dupont (Plomberie + Electricité skills), Salif Kane (BTP skill).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skills Matching feature fully tested and working. Key findings: 1) PUT /api/users/{id}/skills - Admin only, validates category IDs. 2) GET /api/users/{id}/skills - Returns skill IDs and category details. 3) GET /api/interventions/available - Filters by tech skills (techs only see interventions matching their skills or with no category). 4) Polyvalent techs (empty skills) see ALL interventions. 5) Frontend Techniciens page has 'Compétences' column with colored badges and edit button. 6) Skills dialog allows multi-select with checkboxes. 7) Tech PWA profile menu shows 'Mes compétences' with colored skill badges.

test_1_skills_api_endpoints.evidence: Admin can update skills, tech cannot (403). Skills validated against categories. Returns updated user with skills.

test_2_available_interventions_filtering.evidence: Tech with Plomberie+Electricité skills only sees matching interventions or ones without category

test_3_today_interventions_filtering.evidence: Today's interventions correctly filtered by tech skills

test_4_include_available_filtering.evidence: Available interventions filtered by skills when include_available=true

test_5_frontend_techniciens_page.description: Techniciens page with skills column and badges
test_5_frontend_techniciens_page.evidence: Screenshot shows Compétences column with colored badges (Plomberie blue, Electricité orange, BTP red)

test_6_skills_management_dialog.evidence: Screenshot shows 6 category checkboxes with icons, colors, descriptions. Save button works.

test_7_tech_pwa_profile_skills.description: Tech PWA profile menu shows skills
test_7_tech_pwa_profile_skills.evidence: Screenshot shows 'Mes compétences' with Plomberie and Électricité badges

test_8_polyvalent_tech_behavior.description: Tech with no skills sees all interventions
test_8_polyvalent_tech_behavior.evidence: Techs with empty skills array can see all available interventions

bug_1.root_cause: UserResponse creation in login() and get_me() functions did not include skills=user.get('skills', [])
bug_1.fix_applied: Added skills=user.get('skills', []) to UserResponse in both endpoints

mocked_apis.note: All skills matching uses real MongoDB queries. Push notifications to qualified techs implemented in push_service.py.
